name: deskcraft
description: deskcraft L3: help desk window (views, ticket page with conversation and reply composer, status board, unhappy customers, macros, ingest) on the craft-biz-ui suite frame.

tools.name: desk_status
tools.description: Ticket counts by status, messages, unsent drafts, support address, outbox folder.

tools.name: desk_config
tools.description: Show or set the support address (mails from it count as our replies), the sender name and the reply signature.

tools.name: desk_ingest
tools.description: Read .eml files or a maildir (cur/new) into tickets. Threads by Message-ID / In-Reply-To / References, then [D-n] subject tags, then same requester + subject within 30 days. Re-ingesting is a no-op. dry_run stores nothing.

tools.name: desk_ticket_list
tools.description: Tickets, urgent first. Default: new, open and pending.

tools.name: desk_ticket_show
tools.description: One ticket with all messages, internal notes, history and SLA clocks.

tools.name: desk_ticket_update
tools.description: Change status, priority, assignee (null clears), tags (replaces the set) or add an internal note.

tools.name: desk_reply_draft
tools.description: Write a reply as an .eml draft into the outbox (threaded headers, [D-n] in the subject). Nothing is sent. body or macro; {{name}}, {{first_name}}, {{ticket}}, {{subject}}, {{agent}} are filled.

tools.name: desk_reply_mark_sent
tools.description: Mark a reply draft as sent (after sending it from your mail client). The first sent reply stops the first-response clock.

tools.name: desk_macro_set
tools.description: Create or change a reply macro, optionally setting a status and adding tags when used.

tools.name: desk_sla_status
tools.description: First-response and resolution clocks of open tickets in business hours (Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00, AT holidays excluded): met, ok, at_risk, breached.

tools.name: desk_escalate
tools.description: Send a ticket to taskcraft as ticket.escalated (becomes an issue there). Once per ticket; tags it escalated.

tools.name: desk_signals
tools.description: Tickets whose customer mails read as unhappy (deterministic DE/EN keywords, not AI). emit=true sends signal.negative to gaincraft once per ticket.

tools.name: desk_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an EMPTY desk with labelled demo mails (MIME encoded, threaded, one angry customer) and macros.
